_doc: Premix mask: ASNS specification codes that are not checked. Constraints with these
codes are SKIPPED by the LP.
The premix's vitamins and trace minerals are counted from premix_composition.json
and checked like any other nutrient. Only the two it lacks remain here, choline
(V14) and inositol (V15): the FASA team dropped these rules (decisions workbook
Toxins (TX*) are NEVER masked — they are hard ceilings driven by raw-ingredient

stage_overrides._doc: Optional: stage-specific mask additions/removals. Format: {<stage_label>: {add: [...], remove: [...]}}
